versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the training-exam-mgmt skill for comprehensive exam lifecycle management.
- Supports question bank management (objective, subjective, and practical questions), exam scheduling, and online/offline exam execution.
- Enables automated and manual test paper generation with difficulty and topic balancing.
- Includes input and export for grades, automatic/objective grading, and subjective score entry.
- Provides detailed score analysis, weak point identification, and personalized performance reports.
- Automates certificate generation and issuing based on configurable criteria.
